data: La DorMeuse Duval (The Sleeper by the River)

Dans un village sur les bords de la Meuse, Basile Matrin, magasinier d’usine, mène une vie monotone aux côtés de son épouse Rose. La jeune Maryse Duval, revenue de Paris, laissant son rêve de comédienne derrière elle, va involontairement faire basculer leur destin. Leur voisin, correspondant au Quotidien de la Meuse, est témoin du drame comique qui se joue en face de chez lui... (Once upon a time in a rainy country somewhere on the French-Belgian border : two friends neighbors. One lives alone with its dog Flaubert and writes insipid articles in a local newspaper. The other one, Martin, le leader storemanin a factory in "Vallee dela Meuse" is married to Rose, who has intention to die as late as possible as storeman'xife. They live in the same street, houses face to face.When Marise Duval begins her training in the factory, Matrin is so happy. A trip by car later, and a kill returns Matrin to the life which beats in him. Rose, to whom a 'voice' reveals the infidelity of her husband, falls in depression and Matrin, who make feel guilty make all the possible to bring back to her the happiness. But unfortunaltely all his plans will end ony in disppointements.)
